prompt: SNES-era 16-bit pixel art inspired concept rendering of a wide side-scrolling arcade shooter stage backdrop, bold dark outlines, saturated limited palette, crisp pixel-art texture accents, subtle CRT scanline glow, lifted deep-navy shadows that are never pure black. Middle band: a great reef wall rising from the vapor sea across the whole width, coral-shaped mineral towers and arches of tan sandstone and pale rose, hollowed with glowing turquoise windows, draped with ribbon weed streaming sideways in the current. Lower band: rolling gas waves of teal and deep violet that read like water, every wave crest drawn as a wobbling horizontal raster line of cyan highlight, a shimmering surface. Bottom band: a near foreground of dark green-teal reef rock and sandstone ledges with sea-fan silhouettes, outlined in near-black navy. Wet light everywhere, soft cyan rim highlights on every edge, dark teal shadow. No characters, no text, no letters, no user interface.
